title: Harnessing Artificial Intelligence to Combat Online Hate: Exploring the Challenges and Opportunities of Large Language Models in Hate Speech Detection
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the technical performance and classification accuracy of LLMs in detecting hate speech. While it includes 'Muslims' as a religious target category for its empirical analysis of hate speech detection, it does not evaluate religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, morals, or ethical frameworks as a subject of benchmarking.
